title: The plank timer's countdown is never tested
what: No automated test runs the countdown from a goal time: it never checks the set saving itself at zero with the goal time, the 5-second floor, the greyed save before one second, or the Keep / Discard / Keep going question. The one phone test only starts a stopwatch, taps save and takes a picture.
expected: A test that starts a countdown, lets it reach zero and checks the set is ticked once with the goal time, plus the floor, the greyed save and the stop question.
fix_line: Add a test that runs a short countdown to zero and checks the saved time and tick, and one for the stop question

title: A test locks in the quiet fallback the Weight step journey forbids
what: The journey says a saved Weight step value the app does not know must not quietly turn into another choice. The test asserts the opposite: an unknown saved value falls back to Standard with no word to the member.
expected: Either the journey or the app decides: if quiet fallback is wanted, the journey line goes; if not, the app says so and the test checks that.
fix_line: Pick one rule for an unknown saved setting and make the journey and the test say the same

title: The import privacy promises are never tested
what: Nothing checks that a Hevy or Strong file stays on the phone, that the Hevy link page is read in a hidden private browser that keeps nothing and asks for no sign-in, or that imported workouts reach Health Connect only as the member's setting allows.
expected: Tests that the import sends nothing to a MettleUp server, that the link reader stays private, and that a member who chose not to send past workouts gets none sent.
fix_line: Add tests for the three privacy promises of the import

title: When saving a routine change fails, no test checks what the member sees
what: Two failure paths have no test: a new routine that could not be made ('Could not create routine'), and a muscle tip whose Add or Swap fails ('Couldn't add it', 'Your routine has changed'). Nothing checks that no half-made routine or half-done swap is left and that the tip stays.
expected: A test per failure that forces the save to fail and checks the message, that nothing changed, and that the tip or Routines tab is as before.
fix_line: Add failure tests for making a routine and for a muscle tip's Add and Swap

title: The folder and workout name sheet is barely tested
what: Making a new folder, renaming a past workout, a blank name, the 60-letter limit, a double tap and cancelling a half-typed name have no test. Only renaming a folder is driven once, without checking the result.
expected: Tests for a new folder (no blank, no double, trimmed), the workout rename and its failure message, and a cancelled edit leaving the old name.
fix_line: Add a short phone test for new folder and workout rename, and unit checks for the blank and long name

title: The month's 'Days you trained' calendar is only photographed
what: The phone test scrolls to the calendar and takes a picture; nothing checks the filled days, the heading count, the today ring, a finished month, the empty month or a deleted workout. Only the list of trained dates is checked as data.
expected: Tests that the heading count matches the filled days, the first of the month sits on the right weekday, the empty month shows its words, and deleting a day's only workout clears it.
fix_line: Add checks on the calendar's filled days and the empty-month words

title: No test checks that a backdated workout stays out of the gym's numbers
what: A member can log a past workout dated before they joined a gym. No test checks that such a workout is left out of the gym's figures for that member, or that it cannot win an offer or move them up the board when the gym's rules leave it out.
expected: A test that logs a workout dated before the join day and checks the gym figures, offers and board ignore it.
fix_line: Add a test that a workout dated before joining never counts for the gym

title: The 'Rest alerts' fix row is never tapped or read by a phone test
what: The phone test only photographs Settings with or without the 'May be late' row and asserts nothing; no test taps the row to the right Android page or checks the Silent, held back and blocked rows' words. The states are checked only as data.
expected: A phone test that turns off one permission, sees the matching row, taps it and lands on the right Android page.
fix_line: Make the phone test assert the row and its tap instead of only taking a picture
